There is an error in the print. Under disciplines it says "These are
supernatural powers that a vampire possesses. The Disciplines possessed by
a vampire are represented by the group of symbols in the lower RIGHT
corner."

All readers should note that the previous edition has the symbols in the
lower right corner, but that the Camrilla edition has them in the lower left
corner
